On 8/29/2011 2:55 PM, Jason wrote:
> Is there a way to manually control the spacing between facet panels?

opts(panel.margin=unit(1, "in"))

You probably don't want it that big, though.

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Manual Spacing between facet panels?
parts:
On 8/30/2011 5:35 AM, Jason Curole wrote:
> Yes, 1 inch exceeds my needs. Thanks so much for the help.
>
> So, on this note, is there a ggplot equivalent to trellis' trellis.par.get()
> which would allow one to peruse the available options?

The two best references for available options are Table 8.1 (page 143)
of Hadley's book and the wiki page of opts
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/+opts%28%29-List The results of
theme_get() (or theme_grey() or theme_bw()) give many of them, but not
necessarily all. I don't know of any programmatic way of generating a
list of all valid opts.

> Best, Jason

messages.subject: Re: Manual Spacing between facet panels?
parts:
> I don't know of any programmatic way of generating a
> list of all valid opts.

For the next release, we've added documentation of the theme options,
which lists all the opts and usage examples. The wiki page was a big
help in that regard. Soon, you'll be able to say ?opts, and get them
right from R. Those using the development branch may be able to see
this now, but I'm not certain this is the case.
